What's included

The details are handled. You enjoy the mountain.

From your first transfer to your final day on the slopes, see the core comforts and practical support that can make a ski week feel effortless.

Genuinely all-inclusive

Lift pass, chalet, transfers, breakfast and dinner, gear fitting — all in the headline price. The only thing you'll spend on is vin chaud.

Real ski-in, ski-out

Every chalet is verified on foot by our team — not just "close to the slopes". Boots on at the door, skis off at the terrace.

Private airport transfers

Geneva, Zurich, Innsbruck, Turin or Salzburg. A driver with your name on a board, and a van that fits the skis.

Gear delivered, fitted

Skis, boards and boots from this season's fleet, sized in advance and waiting at the chalet. Swap anything, any day, free.

Local guides, not brochures

Two mornings with a guide who grew up on the mountain. They know where the powder sits three days after the storm.

Snow guarantee

If the valley can't open, we move you to a higher resort at our cost — or refund the days you lose. In writing, in the contract.

Good questions

Everything to know before you go.

Find clear answers about package inclusions, travel arrangements and planning your ski week.

View sample packages

Accommodation, lift pass, airport transfers both ways, breakfast every day, dinner on five or six nights depending on the package, ski or snowboard rental with in-chalet fitting, and your guide days. What's not included: flights, lunches on the mountain, drinks outside dinner, and travel insurance. There are no resort fees or cleaning surcharges added later.

Yes, if you'd like us to. Use the Flights & hotels planner to pick a sample routing and a stay, and we add them to your enquiry. Prefer to book flights yourself and keep your points and seats? That works too: we'll send you a short list of routings that land inside our free transfer windows, and our transfer will be waiting either way.

Our snow guarantee is written into the booking contract. If fewer than 40% of your resort's lifts are open on arrival, we relocate you to a higher-altitude resort in our portfolio at our cost. If you'd rather not move, we refund the affected ski days. In twelve seasons we've invoked it eleven times.

Of course. Tell us at booking and we'll deduct the rental element from your price — usually €120–180 per person per week. We'll still fit and wax them free of charge on arrival, and there's a locked ski room at every chalet.

Very. Roughly a third of our guests are on their first or second week. Beginner packages include lessons with a local ski school, and every resort we run has a genuine non-skiing programme — snowshoeing, spa days, village tours, wine tastings — that isn't an afterthought.

Free cancellation up to 30 days before arrival, full refund of your deposit. Between 30 and 14 days you can move your dates to any other week in the same season at no charge. Inside 14 days, standard terms apply — but we'll always try to resell the week and refund you if we can.
